objective: FARO STUDIO PLAYBOOK 05 — Italian localization: produce a native-quality Italian locale bundle for one product. Scoped mutation limited to locale files named in the kickoff message.

steps.task: Inventory all user-facing strings of the product named in the kickoff message: i18n/locale files, hardcoded UI strings, store listing files. Return: per-file string counts, i18n architecture (key scheme, placeholder style), and any hardcoded strings that block localization. Always respond in English. Do not edit or run commands.

AUTHORIZATION: edit/create ONLY the Italian locale files named in the kickoff message (e.g., products/<slug>/i18n/it.*). Translate from the EN source with native register: informal 'tu', warm, concise; preserve every key, placeholder ({name}, %d), and HTML entity exactly; watch length constraints for buttons and titles (Italian runs ~20% longer). Do not touch EN source files. If EN source strings are ambiguous or broken, list them and leave the key in English with a TODO comment. Agent communication in English; product strings in Italian.

Review the Italian locale bundle for: key/placeholder integrity (diff against EN keys), glossary consistency, length-risk strings for constrained UI, and tone consistency (informal 'tu'). Return findings first, then verdict: APPROVED / CHANGES-REQUESTED. Always respond in English. Do not edit files or run commands.
